Purchase.title: Purchase Record
Purchase.description: Records representing a purchase of peanuts from a farmer

id.description: The unique ID of the purchase batch

location.description: The location where the purchase took place

totalWeightCatty.description: Total weight in Taiwan catties (台斤)

storageLocation.description: The storage location for this batch

ShellingBatch.title: Shelling Batch
ShellingBatch.description: Processing records representing a shelling operation that processes multiple purchase batches

id.description: The unique ID of the shelling batch

date.description: The date of the shelling operation (YYYY-MM-DD)

sourceBatchIds.description: List of purchase record IDs compiled in this session

outputWeightKg.description: Total shelled peanut output weight in kilograms (公斤)

Setting.title: System Setting
Setting.description: System-wide settings such as administrator authentication hashes

adminPasswordHash.description: The SHA-256 hashed password of the administrator

isConfigured.description: Whether the admin password has been set up
